## 🔔 IMPORTANT NOTICE (v4.2.0 release)

As part of the ongoing improvement, all `.exe` launchers remain replaced with `.cmd` scripts. These scripts work exactly like the original executables.

**TOOLS aren't in the main version. You can download it in the separated zip called `TOOLS_*.zip`**
---

## 🎵 Audio System Overhaul

- The audio control system has been completely redesigned and optimized for smoother and better experience.
- Now uses a more efficient and stable method to control `ffplay` volume.
- Improved responsiveness and reliability when adjusting volume from MPV menus or keyboard shortcuts.

## 🛠️ Installer Improvements

- The installer no longer requires an external 7‑Zip executable.
- It now uses the **native `tar` command** included in Windows 10/11 to extract `.7z` archives.
- This eliminates the need to download and run `7zr.exe`, reducing the risk of false positives and making the installation process faster and more secure.

## ⚙️ Other Internal Improvements

- Several internal optimizations have been applied to improve overall performance and stability.
- Code cleanup and refactoring to make future maintenance easier.


## 📌 Notes

- `mpv` and `ffmpeg`/`ffplay` are not included. Download them from their official sources or use the installer.
- Check **[Official MPV-SW-Capture Website](https://tyras-sw.github.io/MPV-SW-Capture/)** for Installation Guide and more useful guides.
- **ESPAÑOL:** **Revisa el [Sitio Oficial de MPV-SW-Capture](https://tyras-sw.github.io/MPV-SW-Capture/?lang=es)** para la Guía de Instalación y otras guías útiles.

## 🔔 IMPORTANT NOTICE (v4.1.1 emergency release)

Due to some problems with `exe` files have been replaced with `.vbs` scripts as an emergency workaround. Also, all tools are now `.vbs` too.

- Please use `Installer_MPV-SW-Capture.vbs` to run the Installer.
- Please use `Setup_MPV-SW-Capture.vbs` to run the Setup.
- Please use `MSC_Bezel_Manager.vbs`, `MSC_Stream_Helper.vbs` and `MSC_Video_Manager.vbs` to run any of these tools. 
- These scripts work exactly like the original executables.

We are actively working on a permanent solution and expect to restore the executables in a future release.

---

## ✨ New: Tools Menu in MPV-SW-Capture

- A new **TOOLS** submenu has been added under **OTHERS** in the mpv menu.
- This allows you to open the available tools (Bezel Manager, Video Manager, Stream Helper) directly from the mpv interface.
- Also, in the same submenu, you can find **INSTALLERS**, where you can also open the Installer and Setup directly here.
- Provides an alternative way to access the tools without manually launching the `.exe` or `.vbs` files.

## ⏱️ Improved: Version Check Message Duration

- The OSD message when checking for updates (`HELP -> Check Latest MSC Version`) now stays visible for **4 seconds** (increased from 1 second).
- This gives you more time to read the version status and take action if needed.

## 🛠️ Fixed Tool: `MSC_Stream_Helper.exe`

- This tool is now renamed from `MSC_Stream_Manager` to `MSC_Stream_Helper`.
- It also has a fixed functionality. Now, you need to manually search for OBS if it's installed (similar to portable mode).
- Some extra fixes have been applied.

## 🧹 Minor Menu Fixes

- Several minor adjustments and improvements have been made to the menu for a smoother experience.

## 📌 Notes

- `mpv` and `ffmpeg`/`ffplay` are not included. Download them from their official sources or use the installer.
- Check **[Official MPV-SW-Capture Website](https://tyras-sw.github.io/MPV-SW-Capture/)** for Installation Guide and more useful guides.

# 🚀 MPV-SW-Capture v4.0.0 – Major Feature Release & Streamer Tools

Version **4.0.0** introduces a comprehensive set of new features, tools, and optimizations designed to enhance the streaming experience, improve workflow, and give you more control over your setup.

## 🌐 Launched new official website

MPV-SW-Capture now has an official website in Github.
The site is very interactive and you can find the news better than before. You can access here:
# **[MPV-SW-Capture Official Website](https://tyras-sw.github.io/MPV-SW-Capture/)**.

## 🖥️ Menu & Interface Improvements

### 1. Hide OSD Messages (Streamer Mode)

New option under:

> **OTHERS → Hide OSD Messages**

This option hides all on-screen notifications that appear when selecting any menu option, including shaders, crops, bezels, and more. Toggle it again to restore the messages.

Perfect for streamers who want a clean broadcast without pop-up notifications, or for users who prefer a distraction-free interface.

> ⚠️ **Important:** For safety reasons, **RECORD VIDEO** is completely disabled while **Hide OSD Messages** is active. Recording is only available when this option is turned off.

### 2. Mirror Mode

New option under:

> **▶ WINDOW → Rotation → Mirror Mode**

Horizontally flips the image, creating a mirror effect. This is useful for specific visual styles or setups.

### 3. New HELP Menu

Added a dedicated **`HELP`** section with useful utilities:

- **`Check Latest MSC Version`:** Automatically checks whether your installed version is the latest available and displays a message inside the window.
- **`Open MPV-SW-Capture`:** Direct link to the official project website.
- **`MPV-SW-Capture Discord`:** Direct link to the official Discord server for support and community.

## ⚙️ Setup & Configuration Enhancements

The Setup tool has been revamped with new **AUTOSTART** options:

- **`AUTOSTART HIDE OSD MESSAGES (Streamer Mode)`:** Launches MPV-SW-Capture with OSD messages already hidden.
- **`AUTOSTART WINDOWS BORDER+TITLE BAR`:** Allows you to enable window borders and/or the title bar. By default, MPV-SW-Capture runs borderless.
- **`AUTO-CHECK FOR UPDATES ON STARTUP`:** Automatically checks for new versions every time you start the program. Disabled by default—enable it to stay up to date.

## 🌐 Language Persistence Across All Tools

The language selection (**English/Spanish**) is now shared across every program in the ecosystem:
`Setup`, `Installer`, `Stream Manager`, `Bezel Manager`, `Video Manager`.

Change it once in any tool, and all others will automatically adopt the same language—no need to set it repeatedly.

## 🛠️ New Tool: `MSC_Stream_Manager.exe`

A brand-new graphical tool designed to simplify the integration of MPV-SW-Capture with OBS Studio.

### Features

- Two independent profiles: **Portable** and **Installed**.
- Download OBS in both installer and portable ZIP formats.
- Automatically install the required `win-capture-audio` plugin for OBS with one click.
- Manually select your OBS Portable folder if needed.
- Automatically create a new scene collection.
- Add the required sources—**Window Capture** and **Audio Capture**—to an existing scene collection.
- Configure everything manually if preferred.

> 🔐 **Note:** If you are using the **Installed** version of OBS in `Program Files`, you need to run `MSC_Stream_Manager.exe` as Administrator to install the plugin.  
>  
> For the **Portable** version, administrator rights are not required.

## 🚀 Optimizations & General Improvements

- Performance optimization for bezels, shaders, crops, and shapes.
- Faster, polished, reorganized, lighter and more efficient binaries.

## 📌 Notes

- `mpv` and `ffmpeg`/`ffplay` are not included. Download them from their official sources or use the installer.
- Check **[Official MPV-SW-Capture Website](https://tyras-sw.github.io/MPV-SW-Capture/)** for Installation Guide and more useful guides.
- **ESPAÑOL:** **Revisa el [Sitio Oficial de MPV-SW-Capture](https://tyras-sw.github.io/MPV-SW-Capture/?lang=es)** para la Guía de Instalación y otras guías útiles.

## Internal Update & Build Optimization

Version 3.3.1 introduces an updated internal build process for the main executables, resulting in an overall more polished and reliable experience.

### Core Installer & Setup

- `Installer_MPV-SW-Capture.exe` and `Setup_MPV-SW-Capture.exe` have been rebuilt using a new optimized format, ensuring a smoother deployment process.

### Companion Tools

- `MSC_Bezel_Manager.exe` and `MSC_Video_Manager.exe` have also been updated to align with the new build structure.

### Overall Improvements

- The updated executables are now more stable and lighter, performing better and more consistently than in previous releases.

## Notes
- mpv and ffmpeg/ffplay are not included; download them from their official sources or installer.
- Read [README.md ](https://github.com/TyRaS-SW/MPV-SW-Capture/blob/main/README.md#%EF%B8%8F-installation-stepbystep) to know how to setup.
- ESPAÑOL: Si quieres Instrucciones en Español, usa el [LEEME](https://github.com/TyRaS-SW/MPV-SW-Capture/wiki/LEEME#%EF%B8%8F-c%C3%B3mo-funciona-audio--video-con-m%C3%ADnima-latencia).

## New Shaders

- `Inverted Colors`: Adds a full color inversion effect to the video output, creating a negative-style visual appearance.
- `LCD Dust:` Simulates dust particles and subtle screen imperfections to recreate the look of a worn or dusty LCD display.

Both shaders are available in **Shaders -> Special**.

## Shader Fixes

The following shaders have been updated to improve compatibility across different resolutions, helping them scale more consistently and display correctly in a wider range of setups: `GB LCD Color Screen `, `Broken LCD TV`

## Setup Update

`Setup_MPV-SW-Capture` has been updated again with additional improvements and fixes, resulting in a more stable and polished setup experience.

## New Menu Options in `WINDOW`

### `Rotation`

A new **Rotation** option has been added, allowing the screen to be rotated in 90-degree increments.

- Rotate clockwise or counterclockwise.
- Repeating the same option will continue rotating the screen in the selected direction.

### `Other Options`

New window behavior settings are now available under **Other Options**:

- Toggle window borders on or off. By default, the MPV-SW-Capture window remains borderless, but borders can now be enabled if preferred.
- Toggle the title bar on or off, allowing the window to look either cleaner and more minimal or more like a standard desktop window.

## Notes
- mpv and ffmpeg/ffplay are not included; download them from their official sources or installer.
- Read [README.md ](https://github.com/TyRaS-SW/MPV-SW-Capture/blob/main/README.md#%EF%B8%8F-installation-stepbystep) to know how to setup.
